use default

use Token = (line: int, column: int, name: string, value: string)

class LEXER is
    _source: string
    _at: int
    _line: int
    _column: int

    init(source: string) is
        _source = source
        _line = 1
        _column = 1
    si

    tokens() -> Pipe[Token] is
        while true do
            _skip()

            let line = _line, column = _column

            if _at >= _source.length then
                yield (line, column, "End_of_input", "")
                return
            fi

            let start = _at
            let c = _advance()

            if char.is_letter(c) \/ c == '_' then
                while _is_word(_peek(0)) do _advance() od

                let word = _source[start.._at]

                yield case word
                when "if", "else", "while", "print", "putc" then
                    (line, column, "Keyword_{word}", "")
                else
                    (line, column, "Identifier", word)
                esac
            elif char.is_digit(c) then
                while char.is_digit(_peek(0)) do _advance() od

                if _is_word(_peek(0)) then
                    throw _error(line, column, "invalid number")
                fi

                yield (line, column, "Integer", _source[start.._at])
            elif c == '\'' then
                let code = _character(line, column)

                yield (line, column, "Integer", "{code}")
            elif c == '"' then
                _string(line, column)

                yield (line, column, "String", _source[start.._at])
            else
                yield (line, column, _operator(c, line, column), "")
            fi
        od
    si

    _peek(offset: int) -> char =>
        if _at + offset < _source.length then
            _source[_at + offset]
        else
            cast char(0)
        fi

    _advance() -> char is
        let c = _source[_at]

        _at = _at + 1

        if c == '\n' then
            _line = _line + 1
            _column = 1
        else
            _column = _column + 1
        fi

        c
    si

    _is_word(c: char) -> bool => char.is_letter_or_digit(c) \/ c == '_'

    _skip() is
        do
            if char.is_white_space(_peek(0)) then
                _advance()
            elif _peek(0) == '/' /\ _peek(1) == '*' then
                let line = _line, column = _column

                _advance()
                _advance()

                while !(_peek(0) == '*' /\ _peek(1) == '/') do
                    if _at >= _source.length then
                        throw _error(line, column, "end of file in comment")
                    fi

                    _advance()
                od

                _advance()
                _advance()
            else
                break
            fi
        od
    si

    _escape(line: int, column: int) -> char =>
        case _advance()
        when 'n' then '\n'
        when '\\' then '\\'
        else throw _error(line, column, "unknown escape sequence")
        esac

    _character(line: int, column: int) -> int is
        if _peek(0) == '\'' then
            throw _error(line, column, "empty character constant")
        fi

        let c mut = _advance()

        if c == '\\' then
            c = _escape(line, column)
        fi

        if _peek(0) != '\'' then
            throw _error(line, column, "multi-character constant")
        fi

        _advance()

        cast int(c)
    si

    _string(line: int, column: int) is
        while _peek(0) != '"' do
            if _at >= _source.length then
                throw _error(line, column, "end of file in string literal")
            elif _peek(0) == '\n' then
                throw _error(line, column, "end of line in string literal")
            elif _advance() == '\\' then
                _escape(line, column)
            fi
        od

        _advance()
    si

    _either(next: char, both: string, single: string) -> string is
        if _peek(0) == next then
            _advance()
            return both
        fi

        single
    si

    _doubled(c: char, name: string, line: int, column: int) -> string =>
        if _peek(0) == c then
            _advance(); name
        else
            throw _error(line, column, "unrecognized character '{c}'")
        fi

    _operator(c: char, line: int, column: int) -> string =>
        case c
        when '*' then "Op_multiply"
        when '/' then "Op_divide"
        when '%' then "Op_mod"
        when '+' then "Op_add"
        when '-' then "Op_subtract"
        when '<' then _either('=', "Op_lessequal", "Op_less")
        when '>' then _either('=', "Op_greaterequal", "Op_greater")
        when '=' then _either('=', "Op_equal", "Op_assign")
        when '!' then _either('=', "Op_notequal", "Op_not")
        when '&' then _doubled('&', "Op_and", line, column)
        when '|' then _doubled('|', "Op_or", line, column)
        when '(' then "LeftParen"
        when ')' then "RightParen"
        when '{' then "LeftBrace"
        when '}' then "RightBrace"
        when ';' then "Semicolon"
        when ',' then "Comma"
        else throw _error(line, column, "unrecognized character '{c}'")
        esac

    _error(line: int, column: int, message: string) -> System.Exception =>
        System.Exception("line {line}, column {column}: {message}")
si

lex(source: string) is
    try
        for (line, column, name, value) in LEXER(source).tokens() do
            let row = "{line,5} {column,6}   {name,-15} {value}"

            write_line(row.trim_end())
        od
    catch e: System.Exception
        write_line("error at {e.message}")
    yrt
si

let lines = LIST[string]()

while let line = IO.Std.read_line() do
    lines.add(line)
od

lex("{lines |> join("\n")}\n")

for source in [
    "''", "'\\r'", "'xx'", "/* never closed", "\"no closing quote",
    "\"a\nb\"", "a | b", "123abc"
] do
    write_line("")
    write_line(source)
    lex(source)
od
